name: Cold Verdict 3
source:
It's been two years since the events of 'Cold Verdict 2', but Claire did not waste any minute. Together with a small team of allies, she has been looking for the elusive masked man after his escape and devising a plan to stop him once and for all. After two years of search and planning, Claire has tracked him down. All that's left now is to bring him to justice. But to do that, Claire has to go through another one of his sick games - a race against time to stay alive. And along with her, two others are put through the exact same challenge.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4052180/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《冷判决2》事件已经过去两年了，但克莱尔没有浪费任何一分钟。她与一小队盟友一起，一直在寻找这位难以捉摸的蒙面男子，并制定了一个计划来彻底阻止他。经过两年的寻找和策划，克莱尔终于找到了他。现在剩下的就是将他绳之以法。但要做到这一点，克莱尔必须经历另一场令人作呕的游戏——与时间赛跑以求生存。和她一起，另外两个人也面临着完全相同的挑战。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4052180/]Steam[/url]]
